Stone identity, maker, age, and origin are not confirmed.

description:
A beautiful four-pair collection of turquoise and blue-toned earrings bringing together Southwestern silverwork, dramatic dangles, artisan-style stone accents, and bohemian movement. This is one of those lots that gives a turquoise lover several completely different looks in one collection.
Included are:
A dramatic pair of multi-strand turquoise-colored seed bead dangle earrings with silver-tone accent beads
A long pair of delicate silver-tone dangles ending in freeform turquoise-colored stone drops
A pair of blue/turquoise bead dangles finished with rounded silver-tone bead accents
A substantial pair of sterling silver teardrop-form post earrings featuring oval turquoise-colored cabochons and sculptural openwork design
The largest silver pair makes a particularly strong statement, with sweeping dimensional silver forms surrounding the blue cabochons. The remaining pairs range from earthy Southwestern to relaxed bohemian styling, making this a versatile wearable collection.
Photographs show the larger silver pair weighing approximately 15.05 g / 0.530 oz. Additional photographed pairs weigh approximately 3.77 g / 0.133 oz and 4.08 g / 0.143 oz. Length and scale are documented alongside a ruler in the photographs.
Sterling/silver content appears to vary within the grouping; bidders should rely on the detailed photographs of individual construction and any visible markings rather than assuming identical metal content across all four pairs.
A strong choice for a turquoise collector, Southwestern jewelry lover, Western wardrobe, festival/boho collection, or jewelry reseller. The variety of sizes and silhouettes also makes this an appealing lot for someone who wants both everyday turquoise and larger statement pieces.
Condition: Pre-owned estate condition with expected surface wear, oxidation/patina, and signs of previous use. Natural stones and stone-like components may show inherent variations in color, matrix, shape, and texture. Please review all photographs for backs, findings, posts, hooks, stones, and overall condition.
Shipping: Shippable. Earrings will be carefully packaged for transport.
